RETICLE GUIDE
Center dot: aim point · Inner ticks: aimed spread · Diagonal ticks: current spread
Inner tick range warning: amber means reduced damage · Red means out of range
Outer diagonal ticks glow red while firing, then cool down
A full gold ring readies the next critical shot · Double slashes confirm a hit
Reloading or charging replaces the aiming ticks with a progress ring
